The Red Year (3)
Violence Against Companies and the Republican Party
Domestic Terrorism Against Tesla
Please recall the early months of the Trump Administration when Elon Musk left his many corporate duties to lead the DOGE team. This team’s goal was to assess spending throughout the federal government and propose cuts where waste, fraud or abuse was found.
In response, the terrorist Left attacked Musk’s Tesla car company throughout the United States. Tesla dealerships were attacked using arson, gunfire and threats. Tesla owners had their personal cars vandalized and burned. A March, 2025 PowerLine post summarized the situation.
The coordinated attacks on Teslas, Tesla drivers and Tesla dealers represent one of the most appalling political developments of recent years. These attacks are coordinated, organized and financed: yesterday was proclaimed a “global day of action” by the “Tesla Takedown” movement.
[CNN]found the violence exciting. …Tennessee’s Marsha Blackburn introduced a
[resolution]condemning the anti-Tesla violence. …But it was too much for Democrats to swallow: they killed the resolution. …
Democrats have a long history of using violence and threats of violence to achieve their political goals, going back to the Ku Klux Klan, and beyond. Today’s vote, and the resounding silence of every Democratic politician in the face of domestic terrorism, represent a disgusting continuation of that tradition.
The Democrat politicians refused to condemn this domestic terrorism because the most powerful cadre in their party supported it. In fact, they were the people that organized and executed on this campaign of domestic terrorism.
This domestic terrorism extended to anyone who happened to own a Tesla vehicle, regardless of their political beliefs.
But what began as protests at Tesla dealerships nationwide have turned especially ugly. A
[just-released survey]of 508 Tesla owners conducted by the online insurer[Guardian Service]indicates that nearly half reported that their vehicles have been intentionally damaged, presumably at the hands of Musk/Tesla-bashers. What’s more, around three-quarters of respondents fear being targeted moving forward as adverse sentiments toward the automaker continue to foment.
In fact, Tim Walz, recent Democrat Vice Presidential candidate celebrated the economic destruction of Tesla’s stock holders due to the terrorist attacks.
“Some of you know this. On the iPhone, they’ve got that little stock app. I added Tesla to it to give me a little boost during the day — $225 and dropping,”
[Walz said]as the audience erupted in cheers. “And if you own one, we’re not blaming you. You can take dental floss and pull the Tesla thing off.” …But those diving stocks may actually be hurting Walz’s constituents, according to
[a June 2024 report]from the Minnesota State Board of Investment that shows the state held 1.6 million shares of Tesla stock in its pension fund.As of March, Tesla’s stock is down 41.4% year-to-date after a series of vehicle vandalism incidents linked to growing backlash against Elon Musk’s role as head of President
[Donald Trump’s]Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE).
This is the mainline Democrat Party. It instituted and then celebrated domestic terrorism.
Domestic Terrorism Against a GOP Office
The Republican Party’s New Mexico headquarters was attacked in March, 2025.
The
[Republican Party]of New Mexico’s headquarters in Albuquerque was intentionally set on fire in an act of arson and vandalized with a spray-painted phrase “ICE=KKK.”
The message is clear: “Cross the Democrat Party’s interests and we will use violence.”
